en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of an Alpine guesthouse or mountain chalet in a wide meadow, surrounded by coniferous forest with high, rugged, snow‑covered peaks in the background. A tall flagpole with a light‑colored flag stands to the right of the house. Several people in traditional early‑20th‑century rural clothing stand by a wooden fence and gate in front of the building. The architecture features wooden balconies, overhanging roof eaves, and decorative timber framing typical of Alpine inns. Faint text appears on the building's facade and along the bottom edge of the image.
